reconciliation.title: Invoice reconciliation
reconciliation.gate_body: Posting is final. The sale total is compared with every invoice generated from it.
reconciliation.gate_no_sale: This invoice has no parent sale, so there is nothing to reconcile.
reconciliation.gate_ok: Sale and invoices match — safe to post.
reconciliation.balanced: Sale and invoices match — nothing to fix.
reconciliation.acknowledge: I reviewed the differences above and want to post anyway.
reconciliation.no_sale: This invoice is not linked to a sale, so there is nothing to reconcile.

findings.sale_totals_stale: Stored sale total ({{stored}}) does not match the recomputed total ({{computed}}). Re-save the sale to refresh it.
findings.sale_no_items: This sale has no items, so there is nothing to invoice.
findings.sale_zero_total: The sale total is zero — invoicing it would bill the customer nothing.
findings.currency_mismatch: Invoice currency ({{invoiceCurrency}}) differs from the sale currency ({{saleCurrency}}).
findings.invoice_subtotal_mismatch: Sum of the invoice lines ({{lines}}) does not match the invoice subtotal ({{header}}).
findings.invoice_tax_mismatch: Sum of the line tax ({{lines}}) does not match the invoice tax ({{header}}).
findings.invoice_grand_total_mismatch: Subtotal + tax ({{expected}}) does not equal the invoice total ({{actual}}).
findings.invoice_line_math: Line "{{item}}": total should be {{expected}} but is {{actual}}.
findings.invoice_line_tax_math: Line "{{item}}": tax should be {{expected}} but is {{actual}}.
findings.invoice_payment_mismatch: Paid ({{paid}}) + due ({{due}}) does not equal the invoice total ({{total}}).
findings.duplicate_sale_item: Sale item "{{item}}" is billed more than once (invoices: {{invoices}}).
findings.duplicate_fiscal_stamp: The fiscal stamp is billed on {{count}} live invoice lines — it may only be billed once.
findings.orphan_line: Line "{{item}}" points at a sale item that no longer exists on the sale.
findings.quantity_mismatch: "{{item}}": invoiced quantity {{invoiced}} differs from the sale quantity {{sale}}.
findings.over_invoiced: Invoiced {{invoiced}} exceeds the sale total {{saleTotal}} by {{excess}}.
findings.sale_status_out_of_sync: Sale status does not match its invoicing coverage.
